subject: Dedicated commit window for Brokersmith — sizing ask & schedule
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Kapoor <maya@brokersmith.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated commit window for Brokersmith — sizing ask & schedule

Maya — good to meet last week. Thanks for the level-setting call. Per our notes: you indicated Brokersmith wants a guaranteed pool for model evaluation + a daily burst window for peak inference. To move forward with commercial sizing and timeline, can you confirm the following so we can lock the reserve?

- Minimum sustained capacity you want reserved (GPU-equivalent slots and instance type)
- Typical burst pattern (hours/day, duration, regional preference)
- Target start date for the reserved commitment
- Any hard SLOs (p99 latency, availability) we must guarantee

I've attached a short capacity worksheet that maps common patterns to committed slot counts (capacity_model_v3.xlsx). If you can send the procurement timeline and the person who will sign the SOW, I’ll coordinate a proposed commit window and pricing.

Two internal notes: I’m looping Ben and Laura for commercial sizing and infra feasibility. If this needs faster attention we can schedule a short call with Marcus.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: capacity_model_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Maya Kapoor <maya@brokersmith.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Brokersmith Procurement <procurement@brokersmith.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated commit window for Brokersmith — sizing ask & schedule

Thanks Rafael — short answers below and attaching our procurement timeline.

- Minimum reserved: 12 A100-equivalent GPUs (we currently run mixed batch/online workloads; baseline sustained traffic maps to ~12 slots)
- Burst: daily 2-hour peak window, typically 10:00–12:00 PT, spike to 20 GPUs for validation/regression runs
- Target start: ideally 2027-03-15 but we can accept 2027-04-01 if you need lead time
- SLOs: availability >= 99.95% for reserved pool, p99-infer latency target of 350ms for short-chat models

Procurement note: we have an internal approval window that can be shortened if there’s a commitment buy (one-time capacity hold fee). Timeline attached: Brokersmith_procurement_timeline.pdf

Maya Kapoor
Head of Platform Ops | Brokersmith AI
maya@brokersmith.ai
+1 650-555-0877

Attachments: Brokersmith_procurement_timeline.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated commit window for Brokersmith — sizing ask & schedule

Flagging a capacity conflict: HelioHealth (reserved contract starting 2027-03-20) already consumes a large portion of our Pacific pool the weeks of 3/20–4/10. If Brokersmith needs 12 guaranteed A100-equivalents starting 3/15 we will either need to:

1) Shift HelioHealth burst windows (hard operational lift)
2) Offer Brokersmith a later guaranteed start (4/01)
3) Offer a time-windowed reservation that guarantees 12 during Brokersmith’s off-peak and best-effort burst during overlap

I ran the heatmap quickly and attached a view — the Pacific availability is tight between 3/20–4/03. If they’re open to start 4/01 we can fully guarantee. If they need earlier start we should price the one-time hold to compensate for potential HelioHealth disruption.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: pacific_capacity_heatmap_Mar2027.png (image)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated commit window for Brokersmith — sizing ask & schedule

Rafael / Ben — technical recommendation and commercial levers below:

Recommendation: Offer a staged commit with a hard reservation of 12 GPUs starting 2027-04-01 (Pacific region) and a scheduled daily burst window 10:00–12:00 PT that can use up to +8 additional GPUs if available. For an earlier start (3/15) propose a one-time capacity hold fee equal to 20% of one month’s committed spend to offset re-slicing HelioHealth capacity.

Operational notes:
- We can implement time-window reservations with a scheduling policy and reserved pool tagging; infra efforts are ~5 engineer-days to automate (Grace to scope exact runway).
- SLA exceptions: we can commit 99.95% availability for the reserved pool; burst guarantees would be best-effort with preemption protection during your window.
- Risk: If HelioHealth needs unplanned surge we retain right to preempt non-reserved burst; hardened reserved slots remain untouched.

If Sales approves price uplift for early start we can accept 3/15 with the hold fee. Otherwise propose 4/01 start. Marcus — FYI in case leadership needs to weigh-in on stretch capacity.

Laura Bennett
Head of Product, Dedicated Deployments | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Kapoor <maya@brokersmith.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated commit window for Brokersmith — sizing ask & schedule

Maya — thanks for the fast turnaround and the timeline. Given internal capacity constraints here is the commercial approach we can offer immediately:

1) Guaranteed block: 12 A100-equivalent GPUs reserved in Pacific region, start date 2027-04-01, availability SLA 99.95% for the reserved block.
2) Scheduled daily burst: 10:00–12:00 PT, up to +8 GPUs (20 total) best-effort surge during that window. Burst will be honored preferentially but not guaranteed if a higher-tier reserved contract requires immediate remediation.
3) Early-start option: if Brokersmith needs a 2027-03-15 start we can accommodate with a one-time capacity hold fee (20% of one month committed spend) that compensates for the HelioHealth re-slice risk.
4) Pricing: unit price for the guaranteed block will be X% above baseline for Pacific reserved pool; commercial team will put numbers into HubSpot.

I’ve uploaded a one-page commercial proposal to Drive and linked the HubSpot deal. If this lines up with your procurement timeline we’ll prepare SOW + DS and route for signatures.

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-2027-BROK-1198
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_capacity_models

Let me know if you want a quick call today to lock the early-start hold.

Best — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: commercial_proposal_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Maya Kapoor <maya@brokersmith.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Brokersmith Procurement <procurement@brokersmith.ai>, contracts@brokersmith.ai
Date: Sat, 6 Mar 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated commit window for Brokersmith — sizing ask & schedule

Rafael — appreciate the clear options. We are internally aligned on the 12-GPU guaranteed block but the team is pushing for an earlier start (3/15) because our validation window is tight. Procurement is open to the one-time hold fee; can you confirm exact dollar amount and a short redline for the SOW? If you can get commercial numbers and a draft SOW to me by Monday morning (03/08) I can expedite sign-off on our side.

Cc’ing our contracts team (contracts@brokersmith.ai) for SOW redline coordination.

Maya Kapoor
Head of Platform Ops | Brokersmith AI
maya@brokersmith.ai
